g.text: Autonomous OWASP LLM Top 10 Vulnerability Assessment Engine
Async Directed Acyclic Graph Engine · asyncio.Semaphore(3) Concurrency
Lifecycle States: PENDING ➔ RUNNING ➔ COMPLETED | FAILED | RETRYING
Hash-based signature deduplication · Priority ordering · Drops duplicate exploits
Queries ChromaDB for OWASP LLM Top 10 context & remediation advice
Hybrid Retrieval: semantic vector similarity + deterministic rule fallback
Severity Classifier: Critical | High | Medium | Low
Generates executive summary, impact analysis & remediation prioritization
Correlates findings with MITRE ATT&CK techniques (e.g. T1059, T1190)
Maps real-world CVE examples, adversary tactics & threat actor profiles
Regex sanitizer: Email, Phone, SSN, Credit Card, IP, API Tokens, AWS Keys prior to SQLite write
Tables: scan_history, conversations, preferences · File: data/saife_memory.db
